name: 加具土命
description: 为任意1个棋子附加2层天照效果，然后移除其周围4格内所有的天照地格效果，每消耗一个地格，多附加一层天照，共计最多附加4层。
code: function executeSkill(context) { var caster = context.piece; var target = selectTarget({ type: 'piece', range: 99, filter: 'all' }); if (!target || target.needsTargetSelection) return target; if (!battle.extensions) battle.extensions = {}; var cells = battle.extensions.amaterasuCells || []; var removed = cells.filter(function(cell) { return Math.abs(cell.x - target.x) + Math.abs(cell.y - target.y) <= 4; }); battle.extensions.amaterasuCells = cells.filter(function(cell) { return removed.indexOf(cell) === -1; }); if (battle.extensions.tileEffects) battle.extensions.tileEffects = battle.extensions.tileEffects.filter(function(effect) { if (effect.tileType !== 'amaterasu') return true; return !removed.some(function(cell) { return cell.x === effect.x && cell.y === effect.y; }); }); var layers = 2 + Math.min(2, removed.length); var existing = target.statusTags && target.statusTags.find(function(tag) { return tag.type === 'amaterasu-burn'; }); if (existing) { existing.stacks = (existing.stacks || 0) + layers; } else { addStatusEffectById(target.instanceId, { id: 'amaterasu-burn-' + target.instanceId, name: '天照灼烧', type: 'amaterasu-burn', currentDuration: -1, currentUses: -1, intensity: 2, stacks: layers }); } return { success: true, message: caster.name + '使用加具土命，移除目标周围' + removed.length + '个天照地格，为' + target.name + '附加' + layers + '层天照' }; }
previewCode: function calculatePreview() { return { description: '附加2层天照，并消耗目标周围4格内天照地格；本次最多附加4层。', expectedValues: { baseStacks: 2, maxStacks: 4 } }; }
